skill.name: fastapi-app
skill.description: Build FastAPI backend applications with route handlers, dependency injection, CORS settings, Pydantic models, async database sessions, and JWT authentication.
skill.summary: Creates practical FastAPI backend patterns for APIs, auth, CORS, Pydantic schemas, and async SQLAlchemy.
skill.author: Awais68

security_audit.summary: Most backtick, URL, and reconnaissance alerts are false positives from Markdown examples, sample CORS origins, or normal FastAPI code. The confirmed risks are unsafe copied defaults for database credentials and JWT secrets, plus uvicorn commands that bind to all interfaces. No prompt injection, malware intent, or data-exfiltration behavior was found in the reviewed skill file.

remediation.issue: JWT examples include a predictable fallback secret.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the fallback value and require JWT_SECRET_KEY at startup. Add validation that rejects placeholder secrets.

remediation.issue: Database examples include password-bearing default connection strings.
remediation.suggestion: Show DATABASE_URL as a required setting and avoid default usernames, passwords, or database names.

remediation.issue: Run commands bind uvicorn to every network interface.
remediation.suggestion: Use 127.0.0.1 for development. Explain that 0.0.0.0 needs firewall, proxy, and TLS controls.

remediation.issue: Production CORS examples use placeholder origins.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to configure exact production origins through settings and avoid wildcard-style copying.

content.user_title: Build FastAPI Backends with Auth and Models
content.value_statement: FastAPI projects need consistent structure for routes, schemas, auth, database sessions, and CORS. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create maintainable backend patterns.
actual_capabilities: Creates FastAPI application setup with lifespan events, routers, CORS middleware, and Swagger docs.
Drafts APIRouter CRUD handlers with response models, status codes, pagination, and auth dependencies.
Defines async SQLAlchemy session dependencies and database initialization patterns.
Generates Pydantic v2 request and response schemas with validation rules.
Shows JWT bearer authentication, role checks, and token helper patterns.
Adds rate limiting and environment configuration examples for production readiness.
limitations: It provides templates and guidance, not a complete deployed service.
Generated examples need project-specific models, imports, migrations, and tests.
Security defaults must be hardened before production use.
It does not replace database design or infrastructure review.

use_cases.title: Create a New API
use_cases.description: A backend developer can scaffold a FastAPI service with routers, schemas, database sessions, and CORS settings.

use_cases.title: Add Authenticated ERP Routes
use_cases.description: An education platform team can add student, fee, attendance, and auth endpoints with role checks.

use_cases.title: Standardize API Patterns
use_cases.description: A technical lead can align FastAPI code on Pydantic v2, async sessions, pagination, and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Create a FastAPI App
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a FastAPI backend with a main app, CORS configuration, Swagger docs, and one health route.

prompt_templates.title: Add Student Routes
prompt_templates.prompt: Add authenticated student CRUD routes using APIRouter, Pydantic v2 schemas, async SQLAlchemy sessions, and clear HTTP status codes.

prompt_templates.title: Implement Auth Dependencies
prompt_templates.prompt: Design JWT bearer authentication for this FastAPI app. Include token creation, current user dependency, admin role checks, and error responses.

prompt_templates.title: Harden Production Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the FastAPI backend for production readiness. Improve secrets handling, CORS origins, database settings, rate limiting, logging, and deployment commands.

output_examples.input: Create a FastAPI app for student records.
output: A main application structure with router registration and CORS settings.
Student request and response schemas using Pydantic v2.
A CRUD route plan with database and auth dependencies.

output_examples.input: Add JWT authentication to my API.
output: Token creation guidance with expiry settings.
Bearer token dependency design for protected routes.

output_examples.input: Review my FastAPI config before production.
output: A checklist for secrets, CORS, network binding, logging, and rate limiting.
Specific configuration changes to reduce production risk.

best_practices: Require secrets through environment variables and fail startup when values are missing.
Keep request schemas, response schemas, database models, and routers in separate modules.
Use typed dependencies for database sessions, authentication, pagination, and role checks.
anti_patterns: Do not copy placeholder passwords or JWT secrets into production.
Do not expose development servers on all network interfaces without a clear need.
Do not mix blocking database calls into async request handlers.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build FastAPI backends with routers, schemas, database dependencies, CORS, JWT auth, and rate limiting patterns.

faq.question: Can it generate a complete production service?
faq.answer: It gives strong templates and guidance, but teams must add migrations, tests, deployment settings, and security review.

faq.question: Does it support Pydantic v2?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance uses ConfigDict, Field validation, typed schemas, and from_attributes for ORM responses.

faq.question: Can it help with authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides JWT bearer authentication patterns, current user dependencies, and role-based access checks.

faq.question: What database pattern does it use?
faq.answer: It focuses on async SQLAlchemy sessions with dependency injection for FastAPI route handlers.

faq.question: What should be changed before production?
faq.answer: Replace placeholder secrets, restrict CORS origins, avoid unsafe network binding, add migrations, and run tests.
